subject: Coordination: MAP + Ordering cadence for Novacare pilot
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodai.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@novacare.org>; Benjamin Hart <benjamin.hart@novacare.org>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coordination: MAP + Ordering cadence for Novacare pilot

Hi Benjamin / Novacare procurement team,

Thanks again for the time last week — excited to move the pilot forward. To keep momentum, I put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) that ties the evaluation checkpoints to procurement and legal milestones (MSA, DPA, order form).

High-level ask: can we lock the internal review windows so legal can run in parallel with the procurement PO process? Our proposed cadence below minimizes risk of scope drift while keeping your target pilot start (early Nov) achievable.

Proposed sequencing (very brief):
- Week 1 (eval): pilot technical kickoff + baseline metrics capture
- Week 2: parallel legal review (MSA + DPA) — we provide annotated redlines and evidence pack
- Week 3: order form finalization + procurement PO issuance
- Week 4: pilot cutover and access provisioning

If this looks reasonable, I will send a MAP spreadsheet and a draft order form for your legal and procurement teams to review. If Novacare needs different ordering (PO first -> legal), we can accommodate but it shifts timeline by ~2 weeks.

Attaching: none on this note — I will follow up with the MAP and a lightweight evidence bundle.

Proposed next step: 30-min alignment call this week to confirm review owners and target dates.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwoodai.com
+1 415-555-0124

From: Benjamin Hart <benjamin.hart@novacare.org>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodai.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Oct 2025 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordination: MAP + Ordering cadence for Novacare pilot

Hi Irene — thanks, this is helpful. A couple quick clarifying questions from procurement: 
1) We typically require an internal PO before onboarding vendors; will Redwood accept an interim PO contingent on final DPA signature?
2) Who on Redwood will be the primary contract contact for redlines? Our legal team prefers a single point of contact to avoid parallel threads.

Also copying Novacare Legal on this thread (legal@novacare.org) to confirm timelines for the DPA. If you can send the MAP and the draft order form, we’ll circulate internally.

-Ben
Benjamin Hart
Sr. Manager, Strategic Sourcing | Novacare Health Systems
benjamin.hart@novacare.org
+1 617-555-0889

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodai.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Oct 2025 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordination: MAP + Ordering cadence for Novacare pilot (internal)

Irene / Karthik — quick internal note before we send the files to Novacare:
- I can own the contract contact for redlines (MSA + DPA). Will centralize comments and put annotated doc back to Ben.
- Karthik: can you confirm what evidence we’ll include in the first pass? I suggest SOC2 summary + retention controls + data flow diagram. 
- Risk: if procurement insists on PO before legal sign-off we should offer a conditional PO template (narrow scope + limited spend) to reduce procurement friction.

Irene: happy to be on the call with Ben this week. My calendar is open Thursday 9–11am PT.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodai.com

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodai.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@novacare.org>, Benjamin Hart <benjamin.hart@novacare.org>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Oct 2025 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + draft order form and evidence pack (Novacare pilot)

Hi Ben / Novacare team — following up with the artifacts we discussed. Attached are:
- MAP-Novacare-v2.xlsx (mutual action plan with owners, dates, acceptance criteria)
- redwood-orderform-draft.docx (order form template with pilot pricing and billing terms)
- SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf (one-page summary + link to full evidence folder)

Key notes on sequencing (refined):
- We propose parallel pathing: legal (MSA/DPA) and procurement (conditional PO) run concurrently. Laura will own legal redlines and consolidate comments by 10/22.
- If Novacare prefers final PO after signed DPA we will shift pilot start to 11/10; with parallel pathing our target pilot start is 11/03.
- Acceptance criteria for pilot go/no-go are in the MAP (tab: Eval-Checks). They focus on latency targets, sample throughput, and security checklist items.

Requested dates:
- 10/17: Novacare legal initial comments on MSA/DPA
- 10/22: Redwood consolidates redlines and issues final order form
- 10/24: Procurement issues conditional PO (if agreed) or signals final PO timing
- 11/03: Pilot cutover (if conditional PO + DPA done)

Attached links included in the file: HubSpot deal, Drive evidence folder, and a placeholder DocuSign link for the order form.

Please confirm: (1) your preferred PO sequencing (conditional PO vs PO after signed DPA) and (2) the best time for a 30-min alignment call (Laura and I are available Thu 10/16 9–11am PT or Fri 10/17 1–3pm PT).

Thanks — attaching files now.

Attachments: MAP-Novacare-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-orderform-draft.docx (document), SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Irene
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwoodai.com
+1 415-555-0124

From: Novacare Legal <legal@novacare.org>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodai.com>, Benjamin Hart <benjamin.hart@novacare.org>
Date: Thu, 23 Oct 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + draft order form and evidence pack (Novacare pilot)

Irene / Ben — Novacare legal reviewed the MAP and the draft order form. High-level: we prefer final PO after signed DPA for our larger suppliers, but we can accept a conditional PO for a short pilot if Redwood agrees to the limited-scope clause in Section 2 and a 30-day termination right.

We appreciate Laura offering to consolidate redlines. Please route the annotated MSA/DPA to legal@novacare.org by 10/22 as proposed; if we get the annotated docs and order form on that timeline we can aim for the 11/03 pilot start with the conditional PO.

Next step: Ben to confirm internal procurement owners and I will circulate a short checklist for the conditional PO wording.

- Novacare Legal
legal@novacare.org
